title: I-35E Phase 2 construction

pageHeader.title: I-35E Phase 2 Construction
pageHeader.subTitle: I-635 (LBJ Freeway) to Bush Turnpike
pageHeader.lastUpdated: Updated March 5, 2026 (16 new photos); created May 24, 2024

text:
In July 2021 a $655 million contract was awarded to Lone Star Constructors, a join venture of Fluor and Austin Bridge and Road, for the second (and final) phase of the IH-35E expansion between IH-635 and the Bush Turnpike. The freeway will be widened to 8 main lanes (four each way) and at least two managed lanes. This project required a substantial right-of-way clearance, mostly on the west side of the freeway.

Progress was slow for the first four years, but in 2025 the pace of work improved and substantial progress is now visible.
